top_signals.title: SAAM Towage Receives Carbon Footprint Award in Panama
top_signals.summary: SAAM Towage received the "Carbon Footprint Reduction" award from Panama's Ministry of the Environment (Level 3) as part of the national "Reduce Your Corporate Carbon Footprint" program. The award recognizes the company's efforts to reduce its carbon emissions during the 2024 and 2025 periods…

top_signals.title: Investigation of banking hack leads to arrests in Germany, Brazil
top_signals.summary: Germany’s federal police agency, the BKA, said three suspects were picked up in Europe and charged with fraud, and Brazil’s federal police said four others were arrested on similar charges.
